==English==

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|fro|configurer}}, from {{uder|en|la|configurare}}. See {{m|en|configurate}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfɪɡə(ɹ)/|a=UK}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-configure.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfɪɡ(j)ɚ/|a=US,CA}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfɪɡə(ɹ)/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈfəɡə(ɹ)/|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪɡə(ɹ)|ɪɡjə(ɹ)|s=3}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[set up]] or [[arrange]] something in such a way that it is ready for [[operation]] for a [[particular]] [[purpose]], or to someone's particular [[liking]]
#: {{ux|en|Users may '''configure''' the settings to enhance their experience.}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|autoconfigure|configurability|configurative|deconfigure|misconfigure|preconfigure|reconfigure|unconfigure
|configurable|reverse configure}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|en|configuration}}
* {{l|en|configurator}}
